decision_question: Does pricing the Chainlink-settled event from a causal Chainlink current price and Chainlink window-open strike eliminate proxy-basis errors strongly enough to pass the unchanged A+ contract?

rationale.contract_alignment: The market resolves on Chainlink BTC/USD at the end versus the beginning of the window, while the current fair-value path supplies Binance current and open prices to the binary option formula.
rationale.label_free_selectivity: With every non-anchor input held fixed, the official anchor changed 215 of 2778 fresh orientation-level fee-aware edge classifications across 21 of 24 markets and both directions.
rationale.published_strike_integrity: All 24 captured Chainlink opens matched the corresponding public Polymarket price-to-beat value within 1e-9 USD.
rationale.novelty: This is a settlement-process source correction, not probability shrinkage, a static feature veto, a paired-book transform, a lifecycle rule, or a fitted threshold.

blindness.reason: The candidate was identified after the current block began, so it cannot receive a second-hypothesis score on those outcomes even though the analyst remained outcome-blind.

only_changed_inputs.fair_spot: latest Chainlink BTC/USD source timestamp at or before the decision
only_changed_inputs.fair_strike: Chainlink BTC/USD window-open value used as the public Polymarket price to beat

unchanged_inputs: Binance proxy tape for momentum direction and signal confidence
Binance one-hour realized volatility with decision floor 0.30
binary option formula and annual risk-free rate 0.05
minimum confidence, z-score, reversion, timing, and state gates
decision-time executable asks and price band 0.10 through 0.85
Polymarket crypto taker fee formula with rate 0.07
position sizing, exposure, breaker, latency, fill, and settlement semantics

condition_allocation.start_rule_if_binary_complement_block_1_: start settlement-source-anchor block 1 at the first five-minute condition strictly after the sealed binary-complement block-1 condition set is published
reserve the next disjoint 750-condition block for the unchanged binary-complement replication; start settlement-source-anchor block 1 only after that block seals
condition_allocation.condition_id_overlap_check: must be empty against every binary-complement screen and every prior settlement-source-anchor block

forward_evaluation.comparison: proxy-anchor baseline and frozen official-anchor candidate on identical causal inputs and condition IDs
forward_evaluation.failed_block_action: reject mechanism family without neighbor search
exact_execution_contract: causal official and proxy source timestamps
executable L2 depth traversal and FOK behavior
durable order recovery and live/replay reconciliation parity

promotion_boundary.next_if_both_blocks_pass: implement one default-off runtime variant and run exact measured-latency replay plus live/replay parity; do not enable paper or live trading before all absolute gates pass
